Programmes & Admissions
HKU Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science (SAAS) has a long history of offering study programmes in the fields of Actuarial Science, Decision Analytics, Risk Management and Statistics. The Department currently houses different accredited degree programmes at bachelor and master levels, in addition to MPhil and PhD degree programmes:

Research Focus
Our research can be classified into four main research directions:
Stochastic & Actuarial Modeling
Statistical Methodologies
Biostatistics & Social Statistics
Big Data Science
Stochastic & Actuarial Modeling
The Stochastic and Actuarial Modeling group has major strengths and plays a world leading role in nonlinear time series, time varying conditional variance (GARCH) models, large random matrices, ruin probability, dependent insurance risk.
Discover More
Statistical Methodologies
The Statistical Methodologies group has major strengths in distribution theory, resampling methods, multivariate analysis, and ranking and selection problems. The Statistical Methodologies group has major strengths in distribution theory, resampling methods, multivariate analysis, and ranking and selection problems.
Discover More
Biostatistics & Social Statistics
The Biostatistics and Social Statistics group has strengths in DNA forensic, clinical trials, longitudinal data analysis, survival analysis, epidemiology, human genetics and cytogenetics.
Discover More
Big Data Science
The Big Data Science group focuses on big data analytics, data mining, spatial data analysis, network data models, machine learning (ML) and Al. Extensive collaborations have been established with various government departments and companies in the industries.

HKU SAAS Launches New Actuarial Modelling Course Integrating Industry Practice and Technological Training
The Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science (SAAS) at the University of Hong Kong’s (HKU) School of Computing and Data Science (CDS) has launched, in collaboration with AIA Group and FIS®, an innovative actuarial science course set to commence in September 2025. The programme is designed to equip students with practical skills essential for success in the rapidly evolving insurance industry.

Accreditation
Under an accreditation agreement with the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, HKU joins the ranks of select institutions worldwide that offer the maximum exam exemptions (CS1, CS2, CM1, CM2, CB1, and CB2).

CHAN Ching Yi Cecilia
2022 BSc graduate (Major in Statistics)
Statistics
Studying Statistics at HKU has built a solid foundation for my career. The program offers a broad range of topics to choose from, providing a platform to explore different domains in statistics. This helped me figure out what I'm really interested in and plan my career path. The coursework ensures exposure to both foundational theory and hands-on practice. Beyond that, the environment is supportive and encouraging. Professors are always willing to help—not just with coursework, but also with career advice. The knowledge and skills I've gained from the program have prepared me well for the future.
Discover More
GALINA Chakheeva
Current student, 2025-26 entry
BStat
I am excited to be part of the HKU’s BStat in Statistical Decision Sciences first cohort that perfectly combines my passion for data science with my career aspirations. I chose this program because of its professional core in Decision Analytics, which lies at the heart of modern data science. I'm absolutely fascinated by how data can lead to pragmatic decisions in businesses and technology. I believe this specialization will give me the analytical skills and technical knowledge I need to become a successful data scientist in the future.
Discover More
KAM Ho Yee (Holly)
2023 BSc graduate (Major in Risk Management)
Risk Management
As a 2023 risk management major graduate, I am working as a risk trainee at a top French investment bank serving as the second line of defense. My role is dedicated to inspections of different teams in the APEC region to make sure their work is in line with the bank’s risk management framework.
Discover More
TAO Yufeng
2021 BSc graduate (Major in Decision Analytics)
Decision Analytics
Over the four years growing with SAAS, I have learned an incredible amount both academically and professionally. Professors are kind and willing to help, not just in the classroom. A fulfilling research journey awaits if you actively approach them, and their valuable advice will guide you to the right path. Career advising and professional engagement are among the highlights as well. There is a wide array of internship opportunities along with company visits and corporate mentorship, thanks to the department’s network. Most importantly, the program offers the flexibility to explore what fits you the most. I’m grateful to have spent a summer researching quantitative trading and another working in data analytics. The experiences brought me clarity about my future career.
Discover More
XIAO Fanju Sean
2025 BSc(ActuarSc) graduate
Actuarial Science
I am most grateful that HKU gave me the freedom to explore my path with steady support. The actuarial science programme’s structured curriculum and approachable faculty let me shape parts of my studies and receive timely guidance. The mentorship programme and internships arranged through the department helped me turn coursework into practice and understand how actuarial concepts work in business settings.
